su2025review.summary: A review of safe reinforcement learning methods, power system applications, benchmarks, and practical deployment challenges.
su2025review.overview: Reinforcement learning can support power system operation and control, but exploration and policy deployment may violate operational constraints. This review organizes methods for incorporating safety into learning and decision-making, including Lagrangian approaches, safety layers, and Lyapunov-based techniques. It discusses applications in security control, real-time operation, and operational planning, as well as benchmarks and implementation challenges. The review is a useful entry point for comparing safety mechanisms and their assumptions; the strength of a safety claim depends on the particular method and setting.
questions: Which mechanisms are used to incorporate safety constraints into reinforcement learning?
Where have safe RL methods been applied in power systems?
What challenges remain for scalable and robust deployment?

su2025neural.summary: Neural network certification incorporated into transient stability-constrained optimal power flow under renewable and load uncertainty.
su2025neural.overview: A learned transient stability surrogate can accelerate preventive control, but its predictions require additional scrutiny under uncertain operating conditions. This paper combines a deep belief network with transient stability-constrained optimal power flow and uses the α,β-CROWN verifier to inform stability margins. The resulting certification is used within the optimization process to balance security and operating cost. Numerical evaluation uses a modified western South Carolina 500-bus system. The certification applies to the modeled network and specified uncertainty setting; it should be interpreted within those assumptions.
questions: How can neural network certification inform transient stability-constrained OPF?
How are renewable-generation and load uncertainties addressed?
How can a certified surrogate support preventive dispatch?

su2025grid.summary: A review of grid-enhancing technologies for clean energy systems, published in the inaugural volume of Nature Reviews Clean Technology.
su2025grid.overview: This review addresses grid-enhancing technologies in the context of clean energy systems. It provides a broad research entry point for readers studying how electricity networks can accommodate the energy transition. The article appeared in the inaugural volume of Nature Reviews Clean Technology.

su2026multi.summary: Multi-fidelity dynamic line rating, uncertainty calibration, and load-margin modeling for large-scale offshore wind integration.
su2026multi.overview: This work combines multi-fidelity dynamic line rating with uncertainty calibration and learned load-margin models. It connects fast surrogate predictions to operational security quantities for systems with large-scale offshore wind generation. The study focuses on using transmission infrastructure more effectively while maintaining attention to uncertainty and system load margin.

su2025safe.summary: Safe reinforcement learning for transient stability control of islanded microgrids with topology reconfiguration.

su2023deep.summary: Deep sigma point processes for chance-constrained preventive control of power system transient stability.
